items.title: Harry Edison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Because there was a bus company in Jersey called Lerf, Charlie Lerf, he had a lot of them old busses

ctx.x: We all rode the bus all the time. All the time while I was with the band. The bus got better, we started getting Greyhounds. Because there was a bus company in Jersey called Lerf, Charlie Lerf, he had a lot of them old busses, they’d break down before you got out of New York, most of them. I remember one time I took a plane with the Basie band and the whole band didn’t take the plane. It was Shadow Wilson, myself and somebody else took a plane from Cincinnati to New York, because the band was going to the Roxie…
And you had everything in there….
